text: The more a country leads in financial innovation, the more exposed its disclosure regime is to misrepresentation and fraud, which makes the U.S. regime more vulnerable than Germany's despite being formally stricter.
citation: Painter and Kaal, Initial Reflections on an Evolving Standard Constraints on Risk Taking by Directors and Officers in (2010). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1558614
